## Executive Summary

The .ma ccTLD is currently served by 8 authoritative
nameservers. 6 of 8
authoritative nameservers support IPv6 connectivity, resulting in an IPv6 enablement
rate of 75.0%. The authoritative DNS infrastructure is
distributed across 6 distinct Autonomous Systems, improving
resilience against network and routing failures.

According to Cloudflare Radar (1.1.1.1 public resolver traffic), 22.70% of observed DNS queries resolved to DNSSEC-signed domains and were validated (SECURE), while 75.81% queried unsigned domains (INSECURE). Across major networks, DNSSEC-secured query share ranges from 4.05% to 40.76%.
